decisions: Solid celestial effects instead of baked soft glow
Magenta key for green/teal garden and marine subjects
Five-column first safe gutters, then per-column row gutters to avoid clipping staggered generated illustrations
Fixed square canvases per set, no rotations, stable semantic IDs
Source textures preserved; runtime alpha extracted without brightness threshold
